name: zclass_camera_get_world
description: zClass_Camera::gwCameraGetWorld returns the world node pointer stored in the camera class data.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera accessor; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x449e80 validates the camera class-data load at offset 0x38 and return of the worldNode pointer from offset 0x00.
The native smoke verifies gwCameraSetWorld stores the world node and gwCameraGetWorld returns the same pointer.
